description:
Search, by name, the sub-merchants the signed-in user can act as.

Returns up to 50 matches, each with its merchant_id and name. It is the
search behind the jobmojito_configuration picker's Search button;
list_my_merchants (its `search`) returns the same accounts as text.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

query.description: Part of a sub-merchant's name, case ignored; empty lists the first 50.

name: search_merchants
title: Search sub-merchants
